source.title: Founder's choice, made by Claude at his request: golden tolerance
Founder's choice, made by Claude at his request: golden tolerance

rationale: The engine and the independent check use the same conventions, so they should agree to the shekel: a test passes within 1 NIS or 0.01%, whichever is larger.
rationale_he: המנוע והבדיקה העצמאית משתמשים באותן מוסכמות, ולכן הם צריכים להסכים עד השקל: בדיקה עוברת בטווח של 1 ₪ או 0.01%, הגבוה מביניהם.
chosen_by: Claude, at the founder's request (2026-10-23: "do whatever you think fits")
